newsitem.title: CHINA: Haixing Shipping says reduce interest payment.
newsitem.headline: Haixing Shipping says reduce interest payment.

text.p: Shanghai Haixing Shippping Co said it expected a reduction of 22 million yuan in interest payment on outstanding loans for 1996 as a result of the cut in bank rates in August, a company spokesman said on Friday.

The spokesman said the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC), which holds most of Haixing's long-term loans, had recently decided the formula by which the interest rates on the loans would change as a result of the August bank interest rate cut.

Haixing reported a loss of 85.4 million yuan in the first half of this year, compared with a profit of 50.5 million yuan in the same period of 1995. Last year, the company's net profit plunged 90 percent to 37.65 million yuan.
The spokesman declined to comment on the impact of the reduction on the results for 1997 and 1998. ($1 = yuan)
